host_preimage_rechecked_at_effect.acl: system.posix_acl_access and system.posix_acl_default absent on held ancestors by ENODATA

code_install_effect_route: README fixed here-document loader hashes installer bytes through held source FD then passes exactly those bytes to sudo -n /usr/bin/python3.14 -I -B -S - --install-code-one-shot; execute only after independent review

separate_review_receipt_entry.selection: not included in code installer; distinct reviewer must produce a PASS decision from the frozen v3 bytes/current preimage, and a separate reviewed root-owned exclusive receipt installation must bind its exact bytes/SHA-256. A syntactically valid reviewer field alone is not independent origin proof.

ordered_storage_entries.operation: exclusive create and fsync before descendants

root_execution_inputs.flags: -I -B -S; exact sys.path; 108 root-owned /usr/lib Python and ELF files in runtime-pins.json; both installer and release verify every pinned digest and imported module path before their first selected filesystem mutation
root_execution_inputs.nss: storage release performs no pwd/grp/NSS lookups; storage-only slice allocates no service UID or group
root_execution_inputs.other_reads: Python startup/import and dynamic loader, /proc/self/fdinfo, /proc/self/mountinfo, held ancestor stat/ACL, source and installed payload, review receipt, directory namespace scans
root_execution_inputs.auxiliary_effect_limit: O_NOATIME applies to explicit SHA/readback code paths; interpreter startup/import and dynamic loader execute before in-process pins can verify them and may update access times. sudo/PAM can change timestamp, log, audit, session or cache state. No such effects are included in the three code entries or seven storage entries. Host qualification and exact pre/post accounting are separate mandatory prerequisites; see HOST_PREREQUISITES.md.

metadata_effects: new file/directory mtime/ctime, held parent mtime/ctime for entries, top directory ctime on chmod, possible read atime, fsync durability; root code installer may additionally change /usr/local/libexec metadata
failure_disposition: No automatic rollback or recursive deletion. Once the package or storage top is created, its name is consumed; preserve any partial state and evidence, do not retry the same target.
